sloka: तस्य कानन खण्डेषु निर्झरेषु गुहासु च ।रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यः ततः ततः ॥४-४३-१८॥
transliteration: tasya kānana khaṇḍeṣu nirjhareṣu guhāsu ca ।rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyaḥ tataḥ tataḥ ॥4-43-18॥

translations.english: 'Then proceed to mount Devasakha inhabited by a variety of birds adorning the trees.
